Nails and nail extensions in Pattaya

Choose your shape, length and finish at Kannika on South Pattaya Soi 16. Our nail services include gel polish, nail extensions, strengthening overlays, nail art and maintenance.

Choose your nail service

The menu includes PVC, gel and acrylic extensions, alongside single-colour gel polish for hands and feet. Bring a design reference and discuss the length and shape you prefer. The photograph on this page shows a client's coral nail extensions with white bow details at Kannika.

  • Single-colour gel polish
  • PVC, gel and acrylic extensions
  • Nail strengthening overlay
  • Nail shaping and cuticle care

Finishes, infills and removal

Cat-eye, flash or glitter, and syrup or jelly finishes are listed in the service menu. If you already have extensions or gel polish, tell the salon when booking. An infill, removal or a new set involves different work, so confirm the service and design before your visit.

  • Nail art and special finishes
  • Nail extension infill
  • Gel polish removal
  • Nail extension removal

Before your appointment

How do I get a price for my design?

View the menu, then show the salon your preferred length, shape and design. Confirm any extension, removal or design charges before the service.

Do you offer nail services for feet?

Yes. Gel polish for feet, cuticle care and foot care are listed. See our pedicure and foot care page for more information.
